evidence.caption: Focused safe extraction suite after implementation

pr.body: `safe_extract.py` validates list shape, tuple entries, byte payloads, POSIX path syntax, duplicate/prefix collisions, root type, every existing component, and absent targets before creating paths. It creates missing parents and uses exclusive binary creation to preserve exact bytes. `test_safe_extract.py` adds deterministic cases for malformed inputs, invalid names, collisions in both orders, invalid roots, existing targets, symlinks (including dangling links), percent literals, and no writes on late validation failure. Verified with `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python -m unittest -v` (11 passed) and `git diff --check`. Review covered base a4df26750415c1a03c97a906b88dab874129b8c8 to head a60eeef1238aeea06e7e79a336e6fbec851feb3b; it passed with no findings. Assumption and limit: caller provides a stable filesystem; concurrent mutation and rollback after I/O errors are outside the documented API.
pr.summary: Implemented safe extraction with complete preflight validation and focused boundary coverage. Before: extract was unimplemented. Now: validated regular files can be written in input order without overwriting targets or following links.
pr.title: implement safe batch extraction

risk.why: Filesystem path validation and writes changed. The implementation preflights the complete batch, rejects symlinks and existing targets, and uses exclusive creation; all 11 tests pass and independent review found no issues. The documented stable-filesystem assumption excludes concurrent mutation.
